screens.version: arXiv v2, 27 April 2010; first submitted 21 April 2010
screens.method: Full-PDF lexical scan for conjectures, unknown/existence and future-work passages; introduction, concluding discussion, matched contexts and same-paper resolutions read. Relevant definitions and code-mapping proofs compared; appendices screened.
screens.limit: Section3 defines equality of X/Z spaces. Section5 Lemmas1/2 and Corollary1 prove a locality-preserving [[n,k,d]] to [[4n,2k,2d]] weakly self-dual conversion. Its preservation of the selected absorbing support, Gallager-B votes, first stopping and every supported error recovery has not been established. Section6 Proposition1 concerns Majorana parity and a different commutation law.
